scrub.scope: BRIEF-13.md Part A only: 8 summer and 8 winter scrub props. Reference assets are comparison material only. Shipping-quality calibration, not perfection.

checks.native_and_4x: Inspected all 16 current files at exact 1x and nearest-neighbour 4x in all-prop composites over wasteland dirt and seasonal approved plains, and in irregular mixed-size map compositions. All composites were opened at original resolution.
checks.each_file_8x: Individually inspected every current PNG at exact nearest-neighbour 8x over both charcoal and pale neutral backings. No source image was resampled or edited.
checks.random_8_by_2: Inspected 8x2 single-cell tilings at 1x and 4x, on dirt and seasonal plains, for summer and winter. Random seed 1302; indices 0-3 each occur four times. Repeated copies remain recognizable, especially consecutive identical tufts, but there are no asset-edge seams, enclosed ground squares or connecting tile-border lines. The four single-cell designs are distinct. Dense, aligned placement is a deployment pattern; the irregular mixed map removes the row rhythm.
checks.base_3_by_3: Not applicable: Part A contains only transparent scrub props, no base tiles. Approved bases are comparison substrates, not files under review.
checks.peak_lattice_or_range: Not applicable: no Part A peaks.
checks.trees_in_forest: Not applicable: no Part A trees. Dry shrubs and tumbleweed clumps were composed in a scrub map instead.
checks.dimensions_placement: All 16 files exist. Indices 0-3 are 48x48; indices 4-7 are 96x96. Small visible footprints are 37-38 px wide (77-79%); large footprints are 80-82 px wide (83-85%). All have transparent margins, centred overhead footprints and no cropped extremities or ground square. Vertical height varies with the subject and overhead view.
checks.pixel_grid_alpha: No resampling blur, body antialiasing, stray bright fringe, halo or texture noise found in the 8x inspections. Solid bodies use compact opaque palettes; contact shadows use discrete alpha 80/150. Gullies intentionally have translucent earth/shadow bands (maximum alpha 115), exposing the substrate; these are authored shading, not smoothed opaque sprite edges.
checks.lighting_palette: Muted brown/khaki/olive plants, warm grey stones and top-left highlights fit the approved markers, round-2 tiles, paddies and grass/plains details. Darker right/lower faces and contact shadows agree with the approved lighting. No lush-green shrubs or saturated colour clash. The large tumbleweed is lighter and more open than prop 1, but its khaki twigs remain legible on dirt and plains.
checks.duplicates: No near-duplicate variants: bare branching shrub, paired small tumbleweeds, spiky tufts, small stones, broad shrub patch, open large tumbleweed clump, gully and large stone/brush groups have different silhouettes and internal arrangements. The separate crowns/clumps within prop 4 and prop 5 differ in size and profile.
checks.winter: Every winter file retains its matching summer subject and composition. Snow/frost is placed on exposed plant tips, shrub tops, rock tops or gully banks. Winter 5 uses sparse catches on its open twigs; winter 6 uses restrained bank frost without washing out its connected trough. Neither is blank. Seasonal bases and historical winter scrub were inspected at 1x/4x.
checks.prior_failures: Prop 5, summer and winter: broad perforated shell/ribbon interiors replaced with open, irregular crossing twigs and broken outer strands. Prop 6, summer and winter: continuous pale bevel removed, banks broken and lower contrast, tributaries taper, and the connected trough survives the junction and lower outlet. These specific failures are resolved.
checks.other_requested_failure_modes: Egg-crate peaks, Swiss-cheese craters, classical ruins, stamped cyberpunk grids and flat orange autumn are not present in the Part A file list. There are no tree crowns to assess; the scrub clumps were still checked for copied silhouettes. No unrelated asset receives a verdict.

reference_comparisons: BRIEF-13.md Part A and shared layout/style instructions

scrub-prop-0.notes: PASS retained: byte-identical to the previously approved file; no concrete new defect found in the repeated 1x/4x/8x and map checks. Bare dry shrub has a legible branching silhouette at 1x; negative spaces and small khaki highlights remain clean at 4x/8x. Muted brown/olive belongs with the approved plains details and wasteland marker. No clipped tips, halo, ground square or reversed light.

scrub-prop-1.notes: PASS retained: byte-identical to the previously approved file; no concrete new defect found in the repeated 1x/4x/8x and map checks. The two small tumbleweed balls read as a wiry tangle at native size. Their open crossing strands, different sizes and shared contact line distinguish them from the bare shrub, spiky tuft and stones. Clean native pixels and top-left highlights; no tile border.

scrub-prop-2.notes: PASS retained: byte-identical to the previously approved file; no concrete new defect found in the repeated 1x/4x/8x and map checks. Three unequal spiky tufts read as dry low scrub, with a clear dominant left tuft and smaller right/front tufts. Khaki is dry rather than lush green; strong enough silhouette at 1x without noisy scattered foliage. Clean edges and restrained ground contact.

scrub-prop-3.notes: PASS retained: byte-identical to the previously approved file; no concrete new defect found in the repeated 1x/4x/8x and map checks. Irregularly spaced, unequal stones and two tiny dry tufts form a legible stony patch. Top-left rock faces and darker lower/right planes match the approved lighting. Transparent gaps expose the actual base; no enclosing dirt square or edge halo.

scrub-prop-4.notes: PASS retained: byte-identical to the previously approved file; no concrete new defect found in the repeated 1x/4x/8x and map checks. The broad dry shrub patch has unequal heights, irregular gaps and an asymmetrical outline. Its clustered tops remain identifiable at 1x; the darker twig structure is readable enlarged. Different composition from the small bare shrub, not a translated duplicate. Correct dry palette and top-left light.

scrub-prop-5.notes: PASS after redraw: the 1x dirt/plains and mixed-map views read as loose dry tumbleweed clumps. At 4x/8x the former solid khaki shell bands are replaced by thin crossing twigs and real transparent openings. Unequal left, taller rear and small front/right masses have broken outlines rather than repeated closed rings. Warm upper-left catches, darker branch segments and restrained contact shadow fit the approved art. No halo or clipped tips. Visible footprint 80/96 px wide is within the approximate 85% target.

scrub-prop-6.notes: PASS after redraw: at 1x/4x on plains, a connected dark shallow drainage trace leads from two tapering upper branches through a smaller left tributary to the broader lower-right outlet. Dirt reduces its contrast as expected for see-through earth shading, but it remains a subtle depression rather than an opaque decal. At 8x the banks are irregular, broken low-opacity clusters; the conspicuous continuous bright bevel is gone. No disconnected channel, opaque ground patch, antialiased body edge or halo.

scrub-prop-7.notes: PASS retained: byte-identical to the previously approved file; no concrete new defect found in the repeated 1x/4x/8x and map checks. Three separated boulder/brush groups give the large stony patch a broken, transparent footprint. Different rock profiles and unequal twigs avoid a copied cluster look. Flat pixel planes, light upper-left faces and dark contact edges sit comfortably with the approved detail palette.

scrub.out_integrity: All out/ file names and SHA-256 hashes match the pre-review snapshot; no file in out/ was modified.
